en: This is a sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a view of the Schlossberg hill and surrounding buildings in Graz, Austria. Atop the hill sits a fortress complex, and to the right is the famous clock tower (Uhrturm). The river Mur and a bridge are visible in the foreground, and the city's old architecture can be seen along the riverbank. There is printed and handwritten text on the card.
